cr_data.provenance: Estate of the artist, 1986; The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiu, New Mexico, 1993 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive in 1969 for Canyon Country, 1964, indicates [by Lloyd Goodrich], "Seen in Abiquiú, Dec 1969. Another title is *On the River II*." Whitney Archive in 1969 for *On the River, II*, 1962, indicates, "Notes by Lloyd Goodrich of works seen in Abiquiú, 12/69. Sketch: 'Very Strong x x x.' Marked x for ex." Whitney Archive in 1969 dates 1962 and 1964. Dated c. 1965 on basis of inclusion in 1965 New York (Whitney) exhibition. See cat. nos. 1537, 1538. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Abiquiú Notebooks, Whitney Archive in 1969.
titles.title: Canyon Country

credit_line: Collection of Phoenix Art Museum, Gift of The Georgia Keeffe Foundation (1994.448)
description: Bands of yellow and gray earth run along the bottom of the work. Smooth brown and red mountains in minimalist triangular forms rise above the scene. A white sun or moon-like form glows in the pale orange sky overhead.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Phoenix Art Museum. Photo: Katie Jones-Weinert
title: Canyon Country
